resolved_findings: Producer now keys article versions by canonical URL and content hash; corrected after audit warning. No current same-URL alternate-version loss.
Structured publication fields now normalize HTML entities and preserve raw claims/precision; previously escaped AutocarPro timezone offset is valid ISO.

issues.finding: Numerical duplicate equivalence uses format(float(value),.12g). Prefer exact Decimal equality or source-defined precision, since blanket12-significant-digit rounding can hide tiny same-key transcription differences. No material current value loss independently demonstrated.

limits: Numerical source hashes/transcription checks do not verify source economic truth or historical publication vintages.
National CNG sales do not establish company/city-specific demand.
FY-to-date and monthly totals must not be summed together.
Station indicator is not independently established operating stock.
All later research approvals remain with researcher.
